normothermic ex vivo liver perfusion can be applied for the preservation of liver grafts for up to 11 h and 15 min and that normothermic liver perfusion can prolong cold preservation time of the lungs to 13 h and 32 min, allowing sequential lung transplantation in cLiLuTx.
normothermic lung perfusion can help to prolong preservation times, facilitating long distance transport and combined organ transplants.

the use of normothermic perfused lungs in cLiLuTx can be a safe and feasible option for patients who require a lung transplant and are in need of a liver transplant.
